title: Strict descent for all finite ideal generating slices
statement: Let $(C,J,O)$ be a small ringed site, $I$ a module sheaf, $\iota:I\to O$ a monomorphism, and $K,\epsilon,m$ a specified strictly functorial augmented ring-complex family [def-weil-pbc-ring-complex-cech-data]. Index by all specified finite generating slices [def-weil-pbc-ringed-ideal-generating-index]. Their explicit sheafified ring-family models [def-weil-pbc-functorial-ring-complex-sheaf], augmented to the restriction of $O[0]$ [def-weil-pbc-ringed-derived-restriction], admit strict descent data [def-weil-pbc-augmented-module-complex-glue-data]. No finite-type assumption or derived-category instance is required.

proof.text: For every pair of specified generating slices and common test span, the local equality theorem gives a covering on which their extended section ideals are equal. Supply precisely these coverings to the general ring-family ideal descent theorem.

theorem exists_ringFamily_descentData
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    (O : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u})
    (I : ringedSiteModules.{u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj O))
    (ι : I ⟶ SheafOfModules.unit ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj O))
    [Mono ι]
    (K : RingComplexFamily.{u}) (ε : RingComplexAugmentations K)
    (m : RingComplexMaps K) (hm : RingComplexFunctorial K ε m) :
    Nonempty (SheafOfModules.AugmentedComplexGlueData
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj O)
      (fun p : RingedIdealGeneratingIndex O I ι ↦ p.U) (ringedSiteRingComplex O)
      (fun p ↦ (ringFamilySliceModel O K ε m hm I ι p).1)
      (fun p ↦ (ringFamilySliceModel O K ε m hm I ι p).2 ≫
        (ringedRestrictionRingComplexIso O p.U).inv))
